topic.title: Docker
topic.description: Containers, images, logs, networks, volumes and Docker Compose operations

commands.name: docker ps
commands.description: Lists running containers; with -a also stopped ones, with status, ports and names.

examples.title: All containers
examples.scenario: List every container, including stopped ones.
examples.output:
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE         STATUS                     PORTS                 NAMES
3f2a1b9c8d7e  nginx:1.27    Up 2 hours                 0.0.0.0:80->80/tcp    web
9a8b7c6d5e4f  app:2.4.1     Restarting (1) 5 seconds ago                     api

output_notes.meaning: Container exits with code 1 and the restart policy starts it again.
Host port 80 published to container port 80.
output_notes.anomaly: Missing mapping: service unreachable from outside.

examples.scenario: List containers that have exited.

examples.title: Compact view
examples.scenario: Show only name and status of running containers.

commands.name: docker stats
commands.summary: Live CPU, memory and I/O per container
commands.description: Streams resource usage per container; --no-stream prints one sample.

examples.title: One snapshot
examples.scenario: Print a single sample of resource usage for every running container.
examples.output:
NAME  CPU %   MEM USAGE / LIMIT   MEM %
api   182.4%  1.92GiB / 2GiB      96.0%
web   0.3%    12MiB / 7.7GiB      0.15%

output_notes.meaning: Usage relative to the container memory limit.

use_cases.title: Noisy neighbor
use_cases.situation: Find the container saturating CPU or memory on a shared host.

examples.title: PostgreSQL with a volume
examples.scenario: Run postgres:16 as 'db' with a named volume pgdata and a password.
examples.command:
docker run -d --name db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret \
  -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16

use_cases.situation: Spin up an isolated service to reproduce a bug.

pitfalls: Without a volume, data written inside the container is lost when it is removed.

commands.name: docker system
commands.summary: Disk usage and cleanup of Docker objects
commands.description: Shows space used by images, containers, volumes and build cache, and removes unused objects.

flags.description: Remove stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images and build cache.
With prune: also remove unused volumes (data loss risk).

examples.title: Docker disk usage
examples.scenario: How much disk do images, containers, volumes and cache use?

examples.scenario: Remove stopped containers, unused networks and dangling images.

use_cases.title: /var/lib/docker full
use_cases.situation: Measure before deleting, then prune unused objects.

pitfalls: Never add --volumes casually: unused volumes may hold the only copy of a database.

commands.name: docker volume
commands.description: Named volumes keep data outside the container lifecycle under /var/lib/docker/volumes.

examples.title: List volumes
examples.scenario: List Docker volumes on this host.

examples.title: Where the data lives
examples.scenario: Show the mountpoint on the host of volume pgdata.

examples.title: Back up a volume (reference)
examples.scenario: Reference: archive volume pgdata into the current directory using a temporary container.
examples.command: docker run --rm -v pgdata:/data -v "$PWD":/backup alpine:3.20 tar czf /backup/pgdata.tgz -C /data .

use_cases.title: Before upgrading a database image
use_cases.situation: Know where the data lives and back it up first.

procedures.title: Investigate a container stuck in a restart loop
procedures.context: The api container shows 'Restarting (1)' in docker ps.
procedures.goal: Find the exit reason and whether it was an OOM kill.

steps.interpretation: 137 true: raise the memory limit or fix the leak; 1 false: application error in the logs.

procedures.title: Free disk on a Docker host safely
procedures.context: /var/lib/docker filled the root disk after months of deploys.
procedures.goal: Measure usage and remove only what is unused, keeping volumes.

procedures.goal: Pull, recreate and confirm the stack is healthy.

procedures.title: Fix 'could not translate host name db'

procedures.goal: Check both containers share a network and connect them.

procedures.title: Back up PostgreSQL running in a container
procedures.context: The db container runs postgres:16 with data in volume pgdata.
procedures.goal: Produce a restorable dump on the host.

steps.command: docker exec db pg_dump -U postgres -Fc -f /tmp/app.dump appdb

steps.purpose: Copy the dump to the host
